title: Senior Director of Data Platform Engineering
desc: About Upstart At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. The Team: Upstart’s Data Platform organization builds and operates the data infrastructure and platforms that enable teams across the company to move, store, and use data reliably. The organization currently includes Database Engineering, Data Capture, Data Curation, and Production Experience & Data Governance, with approximately 35 people and 4 managers. This is a platform-focused organization: the team builds the infrastructure and tooling that enable engineering teams to build and own their own data pipelines rather than embedding data engineers directly within product teams. Data is foundational to how Upstart operates, making this organization an important partner across Engineering, Analytics, Analytics Engineering, and Machine Learning Platform. As the Senior Director of Data Platform Engineering , you will lead this organization and set the strategy for Upstart’s data infrastructure. For a Senior Director-level hire, the scope may expand to include Analytics Engineering, bringing the organization to approximately 50 people and five direct reports. How you’ll make an impact Lead and evolve Upstart’s data platform organization, including Database Engineering, Data Capture, Data Curation, and Production Experience & Data Governance, building platforms and tooling that enable engineering teams to develop and manage reliable data pipelines. Set the strategy and roadmap for Upstart’s data infrastructure, developing deep context on business and technical priorities and translating that context into high-impact infrastructure investments. Modernize Upstart’s operational data architecture, partnering with engineering teams to simplify systems, improve reliability and data quality, and reduce technical debt. Develop engineering leaders and teams, establishing clear ownership, operating practices, and technical standards across the data platform organization. Partner across Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Engineering, and Machine Learning Platform to understand shared needs, establish priorities, and evolve Upstart’s data ecosystem. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 10+ years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years of direct people management experience. Experience leading a data engineering or data platform organization, including managing managers and multiple engineering team
